items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I had me, and my cousin Mitchell Frazier... I had Mitchell Frazier, Piano.

ctx.x: I wasn't told. Well did he sound anything like you when you played the blues?

Well I think so, pretty much. We used to fight the blues, but from what I could understand, we were the best blues player. I had me, and my cousin Mitchell Frazier. I had a mic on drums, he's dead. Wouldn't you on climbing? Oh no. Something. I was on climbing.
What band was that? What was the name of that band?
